_comment: Tunables for the intake ball-colour classifier.  ROI is in pixels of the full capture frame; re-measure after the camera is mounted.  Hue thresholds are deliberately wide: venue lighting measured +20 deg of hue drift on the real orange balls.  Defaults assume a DARK pocket: no internal LED, camera mounted very close (it shades its own subject), matte black interior -- hence high exposure/gain and low value floors.  If silver balls start reading as 'none' at the venue, the pocket is darker than even this; that is the cue to revisit the LED.
